tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App background behind every screen. Near-black in dark, warm off-white in light. Never place a gradient over it; depth comes from surface tones, not washes.

tokens.name: surface-1
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups and the tab bar. Sits on bg with no border: the tone step alone separates it. Radius radius-card.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: Wells inside a card, segmented-control tracks, pressed state of surface-1, bottom sheets. In dark it reads raised; in light it reads recessed. All text tokens pass 4.5:1 on it.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, the timer numerals and primary line icons. 14:1 or better on bg, surface-1 and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting text: card subtitles, app counts, schedule times. At least 5.5:1 on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-tertiary
tokens.usage: Least-important text: captions, timestamps, section labels. Floor of the text ramp: at least 4.8:1 on every surface. Never go lighter than this for text.

tokens.name: ember
tokens.usage: Locked-state accent as a FILL: primary button background while locked, the lock ring's fill, Buddy's status light. Same hex in both themes. Not for text on light backgrounds (1.9:1); use ember-ink there.

tokens.name: ember-ink
tokens.usage: Locked-state accent as TEXT or a small icon on bg/surfaces: the word Locked, a lock glyph beside a mode name. 7.8:1+ in dark, 5.3:1+ in light.

tokens.name: ember-line
tokens.usage: Locked-state strokes: the progress arc around the timer, active tab indicator, focus ring while locked. Non-text: 3.3:1+ against every light surface, 7.8:1+ in dark.

tokens.name: ember-glow
tokens.usage: Soft radial halo behind the lock ring and behind Buddy when locked. Decorative only; never the only cue for state. Draw as a blurred circle, not a full-screen wash.

tokens.name: on-ember
tokens.usage: Text and icons placed on an ember fill (the primary button while locked). 8.8:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: slate
tokens.usage: Unlocked-state accent as a FILL: primary button while unlocked, the idle ring, Buddy's light when free. Same hex in both themes. Not for text on light backgrounds; use slate-ink.

tokens.name: slate-ink
tokens.usage: Unlocked-state accent as TEXT or a small icon: the word Unlocked, an open-lock glyph. 5.2:1+ in dark, 5.5:1+ in light.

tokens.name: slate-line
tokens.usage: Unlocked-state strokes: the idle ring, focus ring while unlocked, the tag-ready pulse outline. Non-text: 3.4:1+ on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: slate-glow
tokens.usage: Halo behind the ring and Buddy when unlocked. Quieter than ember-glow on purpose. Decorative only.

tokens.name: on-slate
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a slate fill (the primary button while unlocked). 5.8:1+ in both themes.

tokens.name: track
tokens.usage: The unfilled part of the timer ring and of progress bars. Decorative; progress is always also given as numerals.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Rare: an unrecognised tag, a revoked Screen Time permission. Text and icon colour, 6.2:1+ on every surface. Never used to scold; pair with a plain next step.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dims content behind a sheet or the full-screen unlock moment. Never a gradient.

styles.name: timer-hero
styles.usage: The one huge countdown on the lock screen. SwiftUI: .system(size: 112, weight: .ultraLight, design: .rounded).monospacedDigit(). Max 5 characters (mm:ss or h:mm): drop seconds above one hour. One per screen.

styles.name: timer-large
styles.usage: Duration picker value, the unlocked summary, a timer inside a sheet. .system(size: 72, weight: .light, design: .rounded).monospacedDigit().

styles.name: number-display
styles.usage: Headline stats: time focused today, sessions this week. .system(size: 48, weight: .light, design: .rounded).

styles.name: number-medium
styles.usage: Numbers inside cards: app count, streak length. .system(size: 28, weight: .regular, design: .rounded).

styles.name: number-small
styles.usage: Inline numbers in rows and schedules. Matches body size so it sits on the same baseline. Always .monospacedDigit() when the value ticks.

styles.name: large-title
styles.usage: Top-level screen title, one per screen, one or two words. Maps to Font.largeTitle with .semibold.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Card titles and sheet titles. Maps to Font.title2 .semibold.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: State words (Locked, Unlocked), button labels, row titles. Maps to Font.headline.

styles.name: body
styles.usage: The rare full sentence: onboarding and permission explanations. Maps to Font.body. Keep to one line where possible.

styles.name: subhead
styles.usage: Card subtitles and secondary row text, in ink-secondary. Maps to Font.subheadline.

styles.name: footnote
styles.usage: Settings footers, timestamps, in ink-tertiary. Maps to Font.footnote.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Section labels above card groups, uppercase, in ink-tertiary. Smallest text in the app; nothing below 12pt. Maps to Font.caption .medium with .textCase(.uppercase).

tokens.name: space-2xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside a chip; between the timer and its tiny unit label.

tokens.name: space-xs
tokens.usage: Between a title and its subtitle; between stacked lines in a row.

tokens.name: space-sm
tokens.usage: Between cards in a list group; icon-to-text in rows.

tokens.name: space-md
tokens.usage: Inner padding of compact controls (chips, segmented items); gap between buttons stacked vertically.

tokens.name: space-lg
tokens.usage: Card padding and the screen side margin (generous by default; never less than this at the screen edge).

tokens.name: space-xl
tokens.usage: Between card groups; above a section label.

tokens.name: space-2xl
tokens.usage: Between the timer block and the primary action; top padding under the large title.

tokens.name: space-3xl
tokens.usage: Breathing room above the hero timer on the lock screen; empty-state vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-4xl
tokens.usage: Hero spacing only: the full-screen lock and unlock moments, where the screen holds one object.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, app-icon tiles in the app picker, small wells. SwiftUI: RoundedRectangle(cornerRadius: 12, style: .continuous).

tokens.name: radius-inner
tokens.usage: An element nested 8pt inside a card (card 24 − 8 inset = 16) so corners stay concentric.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Every card and list group. Always style: .continuous. No border, ever.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: Top corners of bottom sheets and the full-screen Buddy panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, toggles, the status pill. In SwiftUI use Capsule(style: .continuous).

duration.note: Durations. Springs are specified in the spring family; these are the timing equivalents for CSS previews and for Reduce Motion crossfades.

tokens.name: dur-press
tokens.usage: Button press-down scale to 0.97 and release. Kept under Reduce Motion (it is not movement across the screen).

tokens.name: dur-lock
tokens.usage: Total settle time of the lock animation (spring-lock). Ring closes, Buddy light turns ember, numerals scale 0.94 → 1.

tokens.name: dur-unlock
tokens.usage: Total settle time of the unlock animation (spring-unlock): deliberately slower and softer than locking, a release rather than a snap.

tokens.name: dur-reveal
tokens.usage: Content appearing after navigation: opacity 0 → 1 with an 8pt rise. Under Reduce Motion: opacity only, same duration.

tokens.name: dur-crossfade-lock
tokens.usage: Reduce Motion replacement for the lock animation: crossfade unlocked → locked visuals in place, no scale or travel. Haptics still play.

tokens.name: dur-crossfade-unlock
tokens.usage: Reduce Motion replacement for the unlock animation: crossfade locked → unlocked in place. Slightly longer than lock to keep the same 'release' character.

tokens.name: dur-ready-pulse
tokens.usage: One cycle of the tag-ready breathing pulse around the tap target (opacity 0.4 ↔ 1, scale 1 ↔ 1.04). Under Reduce Motion: static at full opacity.

easing.note: CSS approximations of the SwiftUI curves, for previews and web surfaces.

tokens.name: ease-lock
tokens.usage: CSS stand-in for spring-lock: a small overshoot, felt as a click into place.

tokens.name: ease-unlock
tokens.usage: CSS stand-in for spring-unlock: no overshoot, a long soft tail.

tokens.name: ease-standard
tokens.usage: Crossfades, reveals and the ready pulse. SwiftUI: .easeInOut(duration:).

tokens.name: spring-lock
tokens.usage: The lock moment: .spring(response: 0.6, dampingFraction: 0.72). Slight overshoot so locking feels decisive. Fire haptic-lock on the first frame.

tokens.name: spring-unlock
tokens.usage: The unlock moment: .spring(response: 0.8, dampingFraction: 0.9). Slower, nearly critically damped, no bounce. Fire haptic-unlock on the first frame.

tokens.name: spring-ui
tokens.usage: Everything else that moves: sheets, card expansion, toggles. Quick and quiet so the two state springs stay special.

haptic.note: Haptic patterns. Implement with UIImpactFeedbackGenerator / UINotificationFeedbackGenerator, or SwiftUI .sensoryFeedback on iOS 17+. Haptics are not affected by Reduce Motion.

tokens.name: haptic-lock
tokens.usage: Lock = two firm taps. UIImpactFeedbackGenerator(style: .rigid).impactOccurred(intensity: 1.0) twice, 90ms apart, the first on the frame the tag read succeeds.

tokens.name: haptic-unlock
tokens.usage: Unlock = one soft tap. UIImpactFeedbackGenerator(style: .soft).impactOccurred(intensity: 0.6), on the frame the tag read succeeds.

tokens.name: haptic-tag-mismatch
tokens.usage: A tag that is not your paired Buddy. UINotificationFeedbackGenerator().notificationOccurred(.warning). Shown with danger text, never with blame.

tokens.name: haptic-select
tokens.usage: Detents in the duration picker and segmented controls. UISelectionFeedbackGenerator().selectionChanged() / .sensoryFeedback(.selection).
